title: EDHOC master_secret mismatch between oscore crate and Python reference
description: Cross-validation test found that the Rust oscore crate EDHOC implementation produces different master_secret values than the Python reference in project-LICHEN. Rust produces 961b7e7f17a6dc0df69ddcdbc750c4fb, Python vectors expect 287085e3960287a06de008620bedba4e. Both use same seeds and RNG mock (0x42 bytes). The oscore crate is external at /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/oscore. Root cause needs investigation.
close_reason: Fixed by updating oscore crate test vectors to match Python reference oracle
